blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Leo Ordiales erupted for 28 points to lead National University-Archipelago Builders past AEP-Cabstars, 25-18, 25-15, 20-25, 25-20, and solidify its hold of the solo second seed in the 2026 Spikers’ Turf Invitational Conference on Wednesday at Filoil EcoOil Centre in San Juan City. Facing their former teammate Leo Aringo, Ordiales powered the Bulldogs with 21 kills, six blocks, and an ace, as they recovered from a third-set loss and improve to a 5-1 record behind their tormentor and unbeaten defending champion Criss Cross.
